decisions.executionNote: Begin elevated approach, gradually pitch grippers downward; right arm toward basket while keeping left in left workspace.
Retry gradual downward pitch and short forward/upward translations after zero-step IK rejection.
Advance above conveyor, continuing smooth downward pitch. Board matches the white remote; right gripper approaches moving basket handle.
Use smaller increments after partial IK guard; finish downward orientation and align right gripper above basket handle.
Align right jaws to the basket's right side rim, tracking conveyor drift; keep left arm stationary and elbow-up.
Set right fingers around side rim, lower slightly and close while tracking basket motion; retention not yet established.
Test basket retention by lifting with right gripper closed; approach matching white remote on left while staying separated.
Basket did not visibly rise; reopen and shift right/down to straddle its actual side rim. Lower left toward remote without closing yet.
Reduce retreat increments after zero-step guard; move right jaw out toward rim while descending open.
Shift right gripper outward and lower to put the basket side rim between jaws; left tracks remote without grasping until basket lift.
Correct outward to side rim and close right jaws around it; compensate moving remote under left gripper, which remains open.
Close at current rim contact, then retract inward while lifting slightly to avoid reach limit and visually test capture.
Basket has not followed lift. Reorient right jaws across its near rim rather than closing inside; left continues tracking remote open.
Correct rejected tensor; same planned open-jaw alignment across near basket rim, with cautious descent and belt tracking.
Move right grasp toward the visually shifted near rim instead of basket interior; keep jaws open for final alignment.
Lift open right gripper clear of basket to avoid further pushing; reacquire rim geometry from above. Left tracks remote open.
From clearance, align across the front rim and descend shallowly; avoid pushing basket from its interior.
Near rim is now centered between right jaws in wrist view; descend into rim height and close without lateral pushing.
Lift and retract the closed right grasp by 12 cm, verifying whether basket follows before picking the remote.
Basket appears to follow right grasp; raise farther and bring it inward. Align and close left jaws on the board-matching remote.
Lift the closed left remote grasp and retract for reach margin. Bring held, elevated basket toward center without crossing arm workspaces.
Remote is visibly retained. Separate from basket rim and raise remote for clearance while stabilizing right basket grasp.
Replan from observed collision deflection with smaller, continuity-preserving retreat and upward increments; retain both grasps.
Raise remote clear and gently pitch right grasp to level the steeply tilted basket, keeping it elevated and arms separated.
Hold elevated basket steady; move remote toward its left opening and tilt left wrist to bring the hanging remote forward over the rim.
Retry remote approach with smaller pitch and translation increments after zero-step continuity rejection; maintain basket hold.
Basket has settled in the closed right grasp. Carry remote over left half of its mouth, pitching forward and retreating slightly to clear rim.
Center remote over basket mouth with a short backward adjustment, then open left jaws while right maintains elevated basket.
Withdraw open left gripper from released remote and allow it to settle in the basket; maintain closed elevated right hold.
Remote is visibly inside basket. Increase basket lift margin gently while moving the empty left arm clear.
Replan from deflected right pose using small upward/outward motion to clear board and preserve basket contents; left remains safely clear.
